rules.title: The MSOnline module is retired and no longer works.
rules.replacement: Microsoft Graph PowerShell SDK (or Microsoft Entra PowerShell)
rules.notes: MSOnline stopped working for all tenants between early April and late May 2025. Install only the Microsoft.Graph.* sub-modules you need and map each cmdlet with the official cmdlet map.

rules.title: Connect-MsolService is part of the retired MSOnline module.
rules.notes: Use Connect-MgGraph -Scopes <least-privileged scopes> (delegated) or -ClientId/-TenantId/-CertificateThumbprint (app-only). Graph permissions are not pre-authorized and need consent. Connect-Entra (Microsoft Entra PowerShell) is an alternative.

rules.title: Get-MsolUser is part of the retired MSOnline module.
rules.notes: Get-MgUser returns only a default property set; request others with -Property (e.g. AssignedLicenses, SignInActivity). Use -All for paging and OData -Filter syntax. Needs User.Read.All (SignInActivity also needs AuditLog.Read.All).

rules.title: Set-MsolUser is part of the retired MSOnline module.
rules.notes: Update-MgUser uses Graph property names (e.g. -UsageLocation, -JobTitle). Strong authentication (per-user MFA) settings are not part of Update-MgUser.

rules.title: New-MsolUser is part of the retired MSOnline module.
rules.notes: New-MgUser requires -AccountEnabled, -DisplayName, -MailNickname, -UserPrincipalName and -PasswordProfile (hashtable).

rules.title: Remove-MsolUser is part of the retired MSOnline module.
Restore-MsolUser is part of the retired MSOnline module.
rules.notes: Use Restore-MgDirectoryDeletedItem -DirectoryObjectId <user id>.

rules.title: Set-MsolUserLicense is part of the retired MSOnline module.
rules.notes: Set-MgUserLicense needs both -AddLicenses and -RemoveLicenses (pass @() for the unused one). Disabled service plans go into the disabledPlans property of each -AddLicenses entry. The user needs a UsageLocation.

rules.title: New-MsolLicenseOptions is part of the retired MSOnline module.
rules.notes: No separate object in Graph: put the service plans to disable in the disabledPlans array of the -AddLicenses hashtable of Set-MgUserLicense.

rules.title: Set-MsolUserPassword is part of the retired MSOnline module.
rules.notes: The official map points to Reset-MgUserAuthenticationMethodPassword. Admin password resets are also commonly done with Update-MgUser -PasswordProfile @{ Password = ...; ForceChangePasswordNextSignIn = $true }.

rules.title: Set-MsolUserPrincipalName is part of the retired MSOnline module.
rules.notes: Use Update-MgUser -UserId <id> -UserPrincipalName <new UPN>.

rules.title: Get-MsolUserRole is part of the retired MSOnline module.
Get-MsolAccountSku is part of the retired MSOnline module.
rules.notes: Get-MgSubscribedSku returns SkuPartNumber, SkuId, ConsumedUnits and PrepaidUnits. AccountSkuId (tenant:SKU) no longer exists; use SkuId GUIDs.

rules.title: Get-MsolSubscription is part of the retired MSOnline module.
Get-MsolCompanyInformation is part of the retired MSOnline module.
rules.notes: Get-MgOrganization returns tenant properties such as VerifiedDomains, OnPremisesSyncEnabled and technical notification mails.

rules.title: Set-MsolCompanySettings is part of the retired MSOnline module.
rules.notes: Split by setting: organization properties via Update-MgOrganization, user default permissions (e.g. allowed to create apps/groups) via Update-MgPolicyAuthorizationPolicy.

Set-MsolDomain is part of the retired MSOnline module.
Remove-MsolDomain is part of the retired MSOnline module.
Confirm-MsolDomain is part of the retired MSOnline module.
Get-MsolDomainVerificationDns is part of the retired MSOnline module.
Get-MsolDomainFederationSettings is part of the retired MSOnline module.
rules.notes: Federation settings are exposed as internalDomainFederation objects via Get-MgDomainFederationConfiguration.

rules.title: Set-MsolDomainFederationSettings is part of the retired MSOnline module.
Set-MsolDomainAuthentication is part of the retired MSOnline module.
rules.notes: Converting a domain to federated is done by creating a federation configuration (New-MgDomainFederationConfiguration); converting back by removing it.

rules.title: Get-MsolPasswordPolicy is part of the retired MSOnline module.
rules.notes: Password expiry settings are domain properties in Graph: PasswordValidityPeriodInDays and PasswordNotificationWindowInDays on Get-MgDomain.

rules.title: Set-MsolPasswordPolicy is part of the retired MSOnline module.
rules.notes: Use Update-MgDomain -DomainId <domain> -PasswordValidityPeriodInDays/-PasswordNotificationWindowInDays.

rules.notes: Get-MgGroupMember returns directoryObjects; user details such as UPN are in AdditionalProperties. Use -All for large groups.

rules.notes: New-MgGroupMemberByRef -GroupId <id> -OdataId "https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/directoryObjects/<member id>".

This cmdlet belongs to the retired MSOnline module.
rules.replacement: See the official cmdlet map for the Microsoft Graph PowerShell equivalent
rules.notes: Some MSOnline cmdlets (e.g. Get-MsolUserByStrongAuthentication, Reset-MsolStrongAuthenticationMethodByUpn) have no direct Graph PowerShell equivalent in the map; review the scenario and use the related Graph API.

rules.title: The AzureAD module is retired and no longer works.
rules.replacement: Microsoft Graph PowerShell SDK (or Microsoft Entra PowerShell)
rules.notes: Microsoft announced that AzureAD and AzureAD-Preview stop working starting mid-October 2025. Bridge option: Microsoft Entra PowerShell (Connect-Entra + Enable-EntraAzureADAlias) runs most AzureAD cmdlet names unchanged while you migrate.

rules.title: The AzureADPreview module is retired and no longer works.
rules.replacement: Microsoft Graph PowerShell SDK (Microsoft.Graph / Microsoft.Graph.Beta) or Microsoft Entra PowerShell
rules.notes: Preview-only cmdlets usually map to Microsoft.Graph.Beta (*-MgBeta*) cmdlets. Bridge option: Microsoft Entra PowerShell (Connect-Entra + Enable-EntraAzureADAlias) runs most AzureAD cmdlet names unchanged while you migrate.

rules.title: Connect-AzureAD is part of the retired AzureAD module.
rules.notes: Use Connect-MgGraph -Scopes <least-privileged scopes> or app-only auth with a certificate. Permissions are not pre-authorized and need consent. Bridge option: Microsoft Entra PowerShell (Connect-Entra + Enable-EntraAzureADAlias) runs most AzureAD cmdlet names unchanged while you migrate.

rules.title: Get-AzureADUser is part of the retired AzureAD module.
rules.notes: Get-MgUser: -SearchString maps to -Search with -ConsistencyLevel eventual (or use -Filter); -All:$true becomes the -All switch; request extra properties with -Property. Needs User.Read.All.

rules.title: New-AzureADUser is part of the retired AzureAD module.
rules.notes: New-MgUser -PasswordProfile takes a hashtable (e.g. @{ Password = ...; ForceChangePasswordNextSignIn = $true }) instead of a PasswordProfile object.

rules.title: Set-AzureADUser is part of the retired AzureAD module.
rules.notes: Update-MgUser uses Graph property names; directory extension attributes are set via -AdditionalProperties.

rules.title: Remove-AzureADUser is part of the retired AzureAD module.
Get-AzureADUserManager is part of the retired AzureAD module.
Set-AzureADUserManager is part of the retired AzureAD module.
rules.notes: Set-MgUserManagerByRef -UserId <id> -BodyParameter @{ "@odata.id" = "https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/users/<manager id>" }.

rules.title: Remove-AzureADUserManager is part of the retired AzureAD module.
Get-AzureADUserMembership is part of the retired AzureAD module.
rules.notes: Get-MgUserMemberOf returns directoryObjects (groups, roles, AUs); details are in AdditionalProperties. Use Get-MgUserTransitiveMemberOf for nested membership.

rules.title: Get-AzureADUserDirectReport is part of the retired AzureAD module.
Get-AzureADUserLicenseDetail is part of the retired AzureAD module.
Set-AzureADUserLicense is part of the retired AzureAD module.
rules.notes: Set-MgUserLicense needs both -AddLicenses and -RemoveLicenses (pass @() for the unused one); AssignedLicenses objects become hashtables with SkuId and DisabledPlans.

rules.title: Set-AzureADUserPassword is part of the retired AzureAD module.
rules.notes: Per the official map use Update-MgUser -PasswordProfile @{ Password = ...; ForceChangePasswordNextSignIn = $true }.

rules.title: This cmdlet belongs to the retired AzureAD / AzureADPreview modules.
rules.replacement: See the official cmdlet map for the Microsoft Graph PowerShell equivalent
rules.notes: Bridge option: Microsoft Entra PowerShell (Connect-Entra + Enable-EntraAzureADAlias) runs most AzureAD cmdlet names unchanged while you migrate.

rules.title: Connect-EXOPSSession comes from the old EXO V1 module, which relies on the retired Remote PowerShell protocol.
rules.notes: Install the current ExchangeOnlineManagement module (v3+, REST-based). For unattended scripts use app-only auth (-AppId, -CertificateThumbprint, -Organization) or managed identity.

rules.title: Connect-ExchangeOnline -UseRPSSession uses the retired Remote PowerShell (RPS) protocol.
rules.notes: RPS was disabled for all Exchange Online tenants from October 1, 2023; the parameter is deprecated in module 3.9.2+. Remove the switch; REST mode needs no WinRM Basic auth. Parameters like -PSSessionOption only work with RPS.

rules.title: Connect-IPPSSession -UseRPSSession uses the retired Remote PowerShell (RPS) protocol for Security & Compliance PowerShell.
rules.notes: Final RPS disablement for Security & Compliance PowerShell was October 2023; the parameter is deprecated in module 3.9.2+. Use module 3.2.0 or later in REST mode.

rules.title: Remote PowerShell connection URI for Exchange Online (New-PSSession) no longer works.
rules.notes: New-PSSession -ConfigurationName Microsoft.Exchange -ConnectionUri https://outlook.office365.com/powershell-liveid/ + Import-PSSession uses RPS, disabled since Oct 2023. Ignore this hit if the URI is only passed to Connect-ExchangeOnline -ConnectionUri (still valid there).

rules.title: Get-MessageTrace is replaced by Get-MessageTraceV2 and is being deprecated.
rules.notes: Deprecation of the old cmdlet began September 1, 2025 (worldwide). Get-MessageTraceV2 is throttled at 100 requests per 5 minutes per tenant.

rules.title: Get-MessageTraceDetail is replaced by Get-MessageTraceDetailV2 and is being deprecated.
rules.notes: Deprecation of the old cmdlet began September 1, 2025 (worldwide). Get-MessageTraceDetailV2 is throttled at 100 requests per 5 minutes per tenant.

rules.title: Search-AdminAuditLog is retired in Exchange Online.
rules.notes: Applies to Exchange Online only; the cmdlet remains available in on-premises Exchange Server. Alternatively use the Microsoft Graph Audit Search API.

rules.title: New-AdminAuditLogSearch is retired in Exchange Online.
rules.notes: Applies to Exchange Online only; the cmdlet remains available in on-premises Exchange Server. Alternatively use the Microsoft Graph Audit Search API.

rules.title: Search-MailboxAuditLog is retired and removed from Exchange Online.
rules.notes: Microsoft confirmed full removal from Exchange Online in a February 18, 2026 update. Use Search-UnifiedAuditLog -RecordType ExchangeItem / ExchangeItemGroup. Still available in on-premises Exchange Server.

rules.title: New-MailboxAuditLogSearch is retired and removed from Exchange Online.
rules.notes: Microsoft confirmed full removal from Exchange Online in a February 18, 2026 update. Still available in on-premises Exchange Server.

rules.title: Get-ClientAccessRule manages Client Access Rules, which are fully deprecated in Exchange Online.
rules.replacement: Microsoft Entra Conditional Access with Continuous Access Evaluation (e.g. New-MgIdentityConditionalAccessPolicy)
rules.notes: Client Access Rules are no longer supported in any Exchange Online organization since September 2025. The cmdlet still works in Exchange Server 2019 or later on-premises.

rules.title: Message trace via the legacy Reporting Web Service is deprecated.
rules.replacement: Get-MessageTraceV2 / Get-MessageTraceDetailV2 or the Microsoft Graph message trace API
rules.notes: Microsoft scheduled the deprecation of legacy Message Trace support in the Reporting Webservice for April 8, 2026 (worldwide). The new message trace is not available through the Reporting Webservice.

rules.title: SMTP AUTH client submission with Basic authentication to Exchange Online is being retired.
rules.replacement: Microsoft Graph sendMail (Send-MgUserMail) or SMTP AUTH with OAuth 2.0
rules.notes: Basic auth for SMTP AUTH is disabled by default for existing tenants at the end of December 2026 (admins can re-enable); the final removal date will be announced in H2 2027. OAuth (XOAUTH2) connections are not affected.

rules.title: Azure AD Graph API (graph.windows.net) is retired.
rules.notes: Extended access ended August 31, 2025; Azure AD Graph requests no longer work. Request tokens for https://graph.microsoft.com and map endpoints with the Azure AD Graph to Microsoft Graph migration guidance; permissions differ.

rules.title: The AzureRM module is retired and no longer supported.
rules.notes: AzureRM was retired on February 29, 2024; it may still run but gets no fixes or support. Az cmdlets use the Az prefix (Get-AzureRmVM -> Get-AzVM). Enable-AzureRmAlias offers temporary compatibility aliases; parameters and outputs can differ.

rules.title: AzureRM.* sub-modules are retired and no longer supported.
rules.replacement: Corresponding Az.* module (e.g. AzureRM.Compute -> Az.Compute, AzureRM.Profile -> Az.Accounts)
rules.notes: Some modules were renamed or merged (AzureRM.Profile -> Az.Accounts, AzureRM.Insights -> Az.Monitor). Do not install AzureRM and Az side by side in the same PowerShell edition.

rules.title: Connect-AzureRmAccount is part of the retired AzureRM module.
rules.notes: Connect-AzAccount supports interactive, device code, service principal (certificate/secret), managed identity and federated token sign-in.

rules.title: Login-AzureRmAccount is part of the retired AzureRM module.
This cmdlet belongs to the retired AzureRM module.
rules.replacement: Equivalent Az cmdlet (replace the AzureRm noun prefix with Az, e.g. Get-AzureRmVM -> Get-AzVM)
rules.notes: Enable-AzureRmAlias, Disable-AzureRmAlias and Uninstall-AzureRm are Az.Accounts migration cmdlets and are excluded. Check the Az 1.0.0 migration guide for renamed cmdlets and parameters.

rules.title: Select-MgProfile was removed in Microsoft Graph PowerShell SDK v2.
rules.replacement: Nothing for v1.0 (just delete the line). For beta: the Microsoft.Graph.Beta module and its *-MgBeta* cmdlets (e.g. Get-MgBetaUser)
rules.notes: v2 ships separate v1.0 (Microsoft.Graph) and beta (Microsoft.Graph.Beta) modules that can be used side by side. Select-MgProfile v1.0 lines can simply be deleted.

rules.title: Connect-MgGraph -ForceRefresh is no longer supported in Microsoft Graph PowerShell SDK v2.
rules.notes: In v2 -AccessToken also changed from String to SecureString; convert plain-text tokens with ConvertTo-SecureString.

rules.title: The Skype for Business Online Connector module is retired.
rules.notes: Change Import-Module SkypeOnlineConnector to Import-Module MicrosoftTeams and connect with Connect-MicrosoftTeams. Import-PSSession is no longer needed.

rules.title: The LyncOnlineConnector module (Skype for Business Online Connector) is retired.
rules.notes: Change Import-Module LyncOnlineConnector to Import-Module MicrosoftTeams and connect with Connect-MicrosoftTeams.

rules.title: New-CsOnlineSession belongs to the retired Skype for Business Online Connector.
rules.notes: With MicrosoftTeams 2.0 or later, replace New-CsOnlineSession + Import-PSSession with Connect-MicrosoftTeams; Cs* cmdlets are then available directly.

rules.title: The legacy SharePointPnPPowerShellOnline module is no longer maintained.
rules.notes: PnP.PowerShell supports SharePoint Online only (not SharePoint Server). It is an open-source community module without Microsoft SLA. Uninstall the legacy module first; several cmdlets and parameters changed.

rules.title: Connect-PnPOnline -ClientId/-ClientSecret uses SharePoint Azure ACS app-only, which is retired in SharePoint Online.
rules.replacement: Entra ID app registration with certificate (Connect-PnPOnline -ClientId -Tenant -Thumbprint)
rules.notes: Azure ACS stopped working for existing SharePoint Online tenants on April 2, 2026 (new tenants since Nov 1, 2024). Apps created via appregnew.aspx/appinv.aspx must move to Entra ID apps. ACS app-only still works on SharePoint Server on-premises.

rules.title: Send-MailMessage is obsolete and does not guarantee secure SMTP connections.
rules.replacement: Send-MgUserMail (Exchange Online) or a maintained SMTP library such as MailKit
rules.notes: Send-MgUserMail needs Mail.Send. Send-MailMessage has no OAuth support, so against smtp.office365.com it depends on SMTP AUTH Basic authentication, which is being retired.
